hero.headline: Decks, pergolas and carpentry in Cairns, built properly from the joists up.
hero.subhead: New decks, deck refurbishments, porches, pergolas and internal carpentry across Cairns and the Northern Beaches. Send a few details and get a clear written quote.

skyeGreeting: G'day, I'm the Green Coast Carpentry assistant. Got a deck, pergola or carpentry job in mind? Tell me a bit about it and I'll help you get a quote or book a time.

about.headline: You picture the outdoor space. We build it to handle the tropics.
about.body: Most people want the same things from a carpentry job: a fair price in writing before it starts, a chippy who turns up when he says he will, and a structure that's sound underneath, not just good-looking on top. Every job is built that way, from checking the joists to the final clean-up.

cards.title: Decks that have seen better days
cards.body: Old decking stripped, joists and supports checked and fixed, then a new hardwood top.

cards.title: Outdoor spaces you'll use

cards.title: Inside jobs and repairs
cards.body: Doors rehung, cabinetry out, skirting in. Internal carpentry and repairs after storms and floods.

about.closing: Not sure what the job needs? Send a few photos and we'll talk it through.

problems.headline: Getting a chippy in Cairns to turn up shouldn't be this hard.

points.title: Unreturned calls & slow quotes
points.body: You ring around and wait weeks for anyone to come and look.

points.title: Vague pricing & surprise costs
points.body: A rough figure that grows once the old boards come up and the joists are rotten.

points.title: Missed timelines
points.body: The deck's half pulled apart and the tradie stops showing up.

points.title: Messy job sites
points.body: Offcuts and old boards left in the yard for weeks.

problems.bridge: You shouldn't have to chase a tradie just to get a clear quote.

services.title: Decks & deck refurbishment
services.body: New decks and refurbishments, with joists and supports made sound before new merbau or hardwood goes down.

services.title: Porches & pergolas
services.body: Front porches and outdoor pergolas built to a high standard and finished cleanly.

services.title: Internal carpentry & repairs

process.headline: We listen to what you need. Quote it clearly. Build it right.

why.headline: We're not here to rush the job. We're here to build it right.

themes.title: Sound underneath
themes.body: Joists and supports checked and fixed, not just covered over.

themes.title: Written quotes
themes.body: Scope and price in writing, so you know what you're paying for.

themes.title: Punctual & reliable
themes.body: Turns up when he says and keeps you in the loop.

themes.title: Attention to detail
themes.body: Clean, careful finishing on every board and post.

realReviews.author: Sarah Christopher
realReviews.text:
Tom from Green Coast carpentry just completed a refurbishment of my deck and I could not be happier! He stripped the old deck, undertook works to make sure the joists and supporting structure were sound, and refinished the top with new merbau. The whole area is now safe and looks just amazing!
He was communicative, identified the things that needed to be done and went through them thoroughly with me, was super friendly, professional and always came to do the works when he said he would, his pricing was really reasonable, and the finished product is absolutely perfect!
Contact Tom for his services! You will be as thrilled as I am A++++

realReviews.author: Kate St Clair
realReviews.text:
We couldn’t be happier with the incredible work Tom did for us. He built our back deck, front porch, and outdoor pergola to an exceptionally high standard, and the finished result has completely transformed our outdoor spaces.
From start to finish, Tom was always punctual, reliable, and professional. He arrived when he said he would, kept everything neat and tidy throughout the project, and showed real pride in his work. His workmanship is absolutely excellent, with great attention to detail and a beautiful finish on every aspect of the build.
On top of his skill and professionalism, Tom was an absolute pleasure to deal with.
He is friendly, pleasant, and easy to communicate with at all times.
We would highly recommend Tom’s services to anyone looking for a quality builder and wouldn’t hesitate to use him again in the future.
Kate & Chris

realReviews.author: Heather Alexander
realReviews.text: Tom was able to excellently complete a full range of different carpentry from removing kitchen and bathroom cabinetry, all internal doors and rehanging new ones. Tom also installed skirting boards to the entire unit. Tom was the main onsite carpenter after Cyclone Jasper floods, he is an extremely competent tradesman, polite and trustworthy. I highly recommend Tom.

finalCta.headline: Ready to talk about your deck or carpentry job?
finalCta.body: Send a few details or pick a time that suits you. You'll get a written quote before anything is booked in.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just a straightforward chat about the job.

faq.a: Send the job through the form or give Tom a call. We'll come and have a look, and send a written quote that lists the scope, materials and price.
Cairns and the Northern Beaches up to Palm Cove, plus the southern suburbs to Edmonton, including Smithfield, Redlynch, Mount Sheridan and Bentley Park. Close by but not on the list? Ask anyway.

faq.q: Can my old deck be refurbished instead of replaced?
faq.a: Often, yes. If the joists and supports are sound or can be fixed, a new top is all it needs. We'll check it properly and tell you straight.
Ask when you request your quote and we'll send the licence and insurance details for your job.

faq.q: What happens after I submit a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight to us, you get a text and email confirmation, and we follow up to book a time to look at the job.
